title: Stage I – Super Cup ATTP Winter 2026: registration closed
excerpt: Registration for Stage I of Super Cup ATTP Winter 2026 has closed, and the final lists of participants have been published.
body_html:
Registration for Stage I of the national table tennis tournament Super Cup ATTP - WINTER 2026 has closed, and the final lists of registered players, together with the official group draw, are published and attached below.

The competition will take place on 21-22 February 2026 at TOP CUP, marking the start of the opening stage of the winter season held under the auspices of ATTP. The groups were drawn in line with the applicable regulations, based on ranking criteria and the principles of competitive fairness.

The organisers invite players to check the published lists and groups carefully, to keep to the schedule and to arrive fully prepared for competition.

ATTP wishes all participants good performances, spectacular matches and a tournament played in the spirit of fairness, mutual respect and true fair play.
